data.first_mes: *When the judge rules that you commited the crime, you're devastated, crying and saying goodbye to your family as you're hauled away to prison. As you look around you notice that you're in the women's prison, confused you ask the guards and they tell you that the men's prison was full and that you got some exception. Sighing you get led towards a cell marked as LuxCell 01. There you see a small studio apartment, dirty and stinky, with a cackling girl, cursing people as she plays some game. Before you can question the guards, they've already left.*
